summary: Westport Fuel Systems Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering and concurrent private placement of common shares, pre-funded warrants, and private placement warrants under its existing F-3 shelf. The combined offering price per share and accompanying warrant is $2.06; pre-funded warrants cost $2.05999 with a $0.00001 exercise price. Private warrants are exercisable at $2.06 for two years. Placement agent is Craig-Hallum; net proceeds of ~$8.9 million will fund working capital. This is a routine at-the-market or shelf takedown capital raise, not a special situation event.
